name: Dumbbell Reverse-Grip Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms supported and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your knuckles up.
Bend both elbows to raise the dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Lower them until the elbows are nearly straight.
tips: Keep your wrists lined up with your forearms.
Keep both upper arms flat on the pad and stop just short of locking your elbows.
